q.en: Change to indirect: He said, 'I am tired.'
q.as: পৰোক্ষলৈ সলাওক: He said, 'I am tired.'

options.en: He said that he is tired.
options.as: He said that he is tired.

options.en: He said that he was tired.
options.as: He said that he was tired.

options.en: He said that I was tired.
options.as: He said that I was tired.

options.en: He says that he was tired.
options.as: He says that he was tired.

explanation.en: The reporting verb is in the past, so the tense shifts back and I becomes he.
explanation.as: ৰিপৰ্টিং ক্ৰিয়া অতীতত, গতিকে কাল পিছলৈ যায় আৰু I এ he হয়।
